plan.scope: Six original layouts with disjoint train/validation/test groups; fixed-budget source-feature ablation
plan.sampling: Same sampled pixel IDs, minibatch indices, step count and validation checkpoints for the three neural variants. Capacity differs only in input-layer columns. Uniform valid-surface pixels; no test-guided resampling.
plan.selection: Lowest mean validation log1p residual MSE checkpoint per model. Select the candidate variant by the same validation metric before test access. Never choose on test or regression results.

gates.rule: Candidate must beat identity and both newly fitted affine baselines by 5% mean log1p RMSE on the untouched test scene; boundaries and posts may regress at most 2% relative to source on any evaluated frame, and marking-contrast error at most 0.002 weighted-log units. Mean temporal error may regress at most 2%. Reference-seed sensitivity above half a claimed gain makes that claim inconclusive, not passed. Report every variant and frame; never relax gates after inspection.

plan.regression_policy: Evaluate all existing 64 frames with frozen new models and old model controls. Retain old references and report their sampling limit. Do not use regression targets for selection.
plan.test_access: Render and evaluate test only after saving all trained model hashes and the validation-selected candidate. No human inspection of test renders before that lock.
limitations: Original material constants; one untouched synthetic test layout is not all-asset coverage
Static original geometry; moving camera and one area light
Synthetic paired targets are not Enfusion ground truth
Integration and varied Reforger environments require separate measured evidence

plan.scope: Frozen-model scene transfer and temporal error diagnostic; no fitting on these sequences
plan.acceptance: For each sequence, lower mean independent-reference log1p RMSE and mean reprojected temporal error than identity; report regional regressions and reference sampling noise separately. No perceptual or gameplay pass is inferred.
limitations: Static geometry, moving camera and one area light
Geometric markings rather than texture decals
No exposure transitions, animated objects, vegetation or engine integration
No retraining or model selection on these test sequences
